scope: Separately authorized causal exploratory gameplay, following the completed offline prediction diagnostic. The failed offline primary gate and all its frozen evidence remain unchanged. This equal-goal slice is a new preregistered question, not a claim that the offline gate passed. No production default promotion or opponent learning.
question: Under identical initial conditions, actual driver, seed, fixed persona and planner budget, does broader public goal-conditioned rollout support improve actual play relative to the legacy two-hypothesis planner and a support-only uniform-coverage control? Report costs, regressions and path-dependent learning honestly.

variants.fixed: Exact legacy deterministic public goal-directed/aggressive alternating sample path, default TacticalControl.opponent_model='fixed'. Existing coordination and four samples retained. The experiment fixes four samples; odd optional sample counts elsewhere retain the original parity imbalance and are not claimed to be an equal-two-hypothesis integral.
variants.uniform-coverage: Outer joint mixture 0.8 legacy fixed hypotheses + 0.2 independent legal-uniform joint action distribution. Coverage mode is drawn once per root/sample from private public-state hashes and persists across rollout. Noncoverage branch retains legacy alternating fixed hypotheses.
variants.goal-uniform: Outer joint mixture 0.8 independent equal-active-goal expert product + 0.2 independent legal-uniform joint action distribution. Per-opponent goal is sampled once from active public root routes and persists across rollout, subject to public completion masking. Experts use existing public tactical_scores, temperature 0.04 and action smoothing 0.08. No learned weights, stored observed-opponent memory or confidence.
variants.randomness: The two sampled alternatives share stateless coverage and action draw namespaces based on root public state, sample, depth and actor. Sampling uses no actual game seed, actual controller label, current hidden intent or current own simultaneous choice. Latents are reused across candidate plans and recovery calls for the same root/sample. Future opponent choices can respond only to each modeled future public state. Legacy fixed path itself stays unchanged. Before gameplay outcomes, the four samples use systematic strata: a private per-opponent public-root hash phase plus sample/samples modulo1 gives exactly two secure and two eliminate latent goals when both are active at four samples; a separate shared coverage phase gives zero or one broad draw at four samples for probability0.2. Per-opponent hash phases are separate. Marginals over private hash phase retain uniform active goals and0.2 coverage, while samples are correlated. Four stratified samples remain a bounded approximation, not exact integration, four independent draws or calibrated joint predictions. The six-step trajectory distribution is not identical to independently applying the offline one-step mixture at every future state: persistent latents correlate steps and their selected goals condition future modeled states. This study tests the whole sampled rollout model, not proof that earlier offline scores or hidden-goal identification cause gameplay improvement.

primary_matrix.controlled: enemy_convergence/both and mixed_junction/both x four unchanged profiles x fresh seeds2701/2702 x three variants =48 games, 16 matched triples. Mirrored existing authored starts, both seats per profile/cell, reference driver, 24-tick deadline.
primary_matrix.heldout: Four familiar condition cells open/secure/reference, choke/eliminate/switch, open/either/raider, choke/both/reference x four unchanged profiles x seed2701+(cell_index+profile_index)%2 x three variants =48 games, 16 matched triples. Every profile two cells per seat; standard starts, 40-tick deadline.
primary_matrix.budget: Exactly96 primary games in32 matched triples, default4 processes and bounded maximum8. No extra variants, seeds, favorable exclusions, replacement games or outcome tuning. Seeds2701/2702 are disjoint from offline1701/1702 and prior64-game591/592/611/612 labels.
primary_matrix.limitations: Heldout uses fresh seeds but familiar scenario/driver families. Repeated profiles/cells, actors and ticks are correlated; matched differences are descriptive causal effects within this finite simulation design, not independent population samples. Persona outcomes need not be equal.

planner: Existing validation_experiment.combat with mode baseline, learn=True using actual feedback only, survival_security=True, progress_watch=True, trace_roots=True. TacticalControl horizon6/samples4/max_plans24/recovery_optionsTrue/recovery_plans48, self_continuation objective, root_completionFalse; only opponent_model differs. Original persona and all value/tier/risk/progress/waste/owner boundaries remain. Forecast rollout data never become actual experience.
saved_evidence: Full before/after states, actual choices, selected routes, real rule audits, purpose masks/feedback and adopted selected-plan rollout samples. Saved fixed root hypotheses are checked against the legacy public helper; sampled alternatives' saved roots are checked by deterministic GoalRollout reconstruction using only public root state and sample index. This is sampler replay, not an independent implementation of its probabilities.

Replay all real rule transitions and progress updates; require exact preregistered initial state, continuous states, full legal joint intent, terminal completion and unchanged persona. Track actual model transition counts and assert original finite per-call cap24+up_to48 recovery plans times4 samples times6 horizon.

For fixed vs uniform-coverage, fixed vs goal-uniform and uniform-coverage vs goal-uniform, locate first own-action difference on identical public pre-state. Assert actual enemy choices equal there and identical choices imply identical real next state beforehand. Record first selected-route difference separately and retain planner adoption/recovery metadata. Later effects may include altered observations, purpose choices and actual-only experience.
outcomes: Actual attempted and failed moves. Partition failed moves into enemy-only, friendly-only, both and unclassified; also report enemy-contested total as enemy-only+both. Denominator is actual movement attempts, not ticks. No moves means null rate, not perfect zero. Show count changes as well as rates so refusing movement cannot masquerade as better movement.

Both final eliminate and secure progress separately; wins, losses and unresolved games; decisions, planned ticks, declines, expired/unresolved stops, unsupported roots, longest actual stall, longest unresolved-stop run, learned uses and regime resets. These are observed outcomes, not inferred hidden opponent goals.

Both partitions, every profile, every scenario and driver family; all32 triples and all96 pairwise contrasts retained. Pooled rates and equal-game rates with explicit empty-domain counts. Paired deltas and lower/higher/tied counts for all outcomes. Do not hide individual/profile objective or stop regressions behind aggregate collision reduction.

Explicit descriptive regressions for each aggregate/profile and each contrast: fewer wins/win credit or lower either objective, more losses/unresolved games/stops/unsupported roots, higher total/enemy-contested move failure or unresolved-stop rate, longer stall. This is a reporting checklist, not a post-hoc adoption gate. No claim of broad benefit from isolated positive cells.

cost.primary: Report full-game wall seconds, planner seconds/calls/recovery calls/model transitions by game and group. Parallel wall time includes shared-host contention and changed trajectories and cannot isolate sampler overhead.
cost.serial_fixture: Four additional cost-only runs on predeclared controlled mixed_junction/both/care/2702: repetition0 fixed then goal-uniform, repetition1 fixed then goal-uniform. Trace execution disabled, all other controls unchanged. Compare actions, real states, feedback/purpose traces, objective/stop/learned-use counts and model transitions with primary trace-on run. Never pool these four repetitions into efficacy outcomes.
cost.interpretation: Save each of two timings per variant and median ratio. Two repetitions on one authored scene are descriptive; no performance threshold or large-NPC real-time claim. Even serial whole-game ratios include path differences, so they are not pure per-forecast overhead. Total declared budget96 primary +4 separate timing games.

freeze: Write immutable preregister.json before any gameplay game: all96 jobs, four timing jobs, all reflex Python SHA-256, all test Python SHA-256, new design and prior geometry, pyproject, exact planner configurations, checkout HEAD and hash-preserved offline design/preregister/evaluation/verification/projection. Verify before/after primary and timing runs. Never alter old offline files, retune after results, silently refreeze or selectively rerun outcomes.
review_and_decision: Independent review required before conclusions. Always preserve default fixed and report defaults_changed=False/default_promotion=False. This experiment tests equal-goal sampled planning only; it does not validate adaptive goal inference, personality identification, long-term opponent memory, general cognition or broad applicability. No push, PR, merge or deployment without parent approval.
